title: Contractual reprice pathways and security-checkbox ops for renewal growth
creator: Elena Rodriguez
description: Goal: produce a single operational playbook and contract-level price-path that lets Sales and CS (a) automate annual true-ups with minimal legal friction, (b) offer conditional multi-year discounts tied to usage smoothing signals, and (c) gate certain uplift discounts behind completed security questionnaire checkpoints. This ticket captures the product policy, contract language proposals, pricing math, and the operational checklist for automation and telemetry required to run a controlled experiment with 20 pilot accounts.
acceptance_criteria: Legal-approved contract language for: annual true-up clause, graduated multi-year discount schedule, grace window and clawback conditions
Rulebook for Sales to offer three pre-approved reprice pathways (Smooth+, Growth+, Secure+) with clearly defined discount ladders and usage thresholds
Automation spec for generating true-up invoices (sheet + GH action) and CRM fields to surface 'eligible for uplift' state
Security questionnaire gating checklist and operational play for ISVs to record completion — integrated into renewal flow
Pilot cohort of 20 enterprise customers onboarded and instrumented; dashboards show expected vs actual uplift within first 90 days
